metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Shared host/instructional isolation and cache/capacity timing limit controlled comparison. Requested alternate child model is known but resolved model, native role binding, tokens and cost are unavailable. Public browser demos failed TLS validation and verified retrieval also returned 403; no bypass was used. Alternative implementations have primary-source research but no actual comparative visual trial. Physical keyboard/IME, native touch, screen-reader use, other engines and natural-speed recording playback remain unverified. Task localization is bounded; source-family bundle advisory remains. Independent acceptance is separate from primary checks.
